headline: Trump administration requests $50,000 million to modernize air traffic control systems
summary: The Trump administration asked Congress for $50.1 billion to modernize air traffic control systems and airport infrastructure.
why: Air traffic control and airport infrastructure spending affects airlines, airport operators and aerospace suppliers through capacity and operating costs.
original_headline: Administración Trump pide 50,000 millones de dólares para modernizar los sistemas de control aéreo
